csv_scope_of_work: The City of Garland is seeking Statements of Qualification (SOQs) from qualified design consultant teams that provide planning, design, engineering, and public art services for neighborhood enhancement projects within the Freeman Heights Neighborhood intended to strengthen neighborhood identity, improve public spaces, and create community gathering opportunities. The City proposes to retain a qualified, capable design firm to serve as the prime consultant of the design team to perform the planning and design for this project. The selected firm will be required to provide a range of professional services as necessary and applicable for the site planning, space programming, design, and construction administration of the project. Potential project elements may include: Neighborhood branding signage Screening structure(s) Portable restroom enclosure Shade structure(s) or pavilion Public art Landscape enhancements Landscape architecture Decorative paving Lighting Public art integration Turf installation and/or repair Landscape and irrigation Site grading to suit improvements Adjacent crosswalk(s) and mobility improvements Drainage channel Site furnishings Site utilities Paving Other amenities/services as determined
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Site Evaluation/Selection, Electrical Engineering, Stormwater, Graphic Design/Public Art
